1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module seventeen: Exam Technique and Final Review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do three things. The pairs the exam likes to confuse. Habits that score points. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All domains. Exam format: one hundred minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official Microsoft Learn A Z-one hundred four study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-six, two thousand twenty-three.

1.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse
1.text: The pairs the exam likes to confuse. Azure R B A C or Microsoft Entra roles. access to Azure resources or access to directory objects. Owner or Contributor or User Access Administrator. everything and access or resources, no access or access, no resources. Azure Policy or R B A C or locks. what resources may look like or who may act or block delete or change. L R S (locally redundant storage) or Z R S (zone-redundant storage) or G R S (geo-redundant storage) or G Z R S (geo-zone-redundant storage). one datacenter or zones or second region or zones plus second region. S A S or stored access policy or access key. limited signed U R L or revoke S A S centrally or full account access. Service endpoint or private endpoint. subnet identity to the public service I P or private I P in your V net.

1.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse, continued
1.text: The pairs the exam likes to confuse. Availability set or availability zone. rack and maintenance inside a datacenter or separate datacenters. Scale up or scale out. bigger instance or more instances. A C I or Container Apps or A C R. quick single containers or serverless microservices with scale rules or image registry. N S G or A S G. filter rules or group V Ms by role for rules. Load Balancer or Application Gateway. layer four or layer seven. Metrics or logs or Activity log. numbers or records in a workspace or subscription control-plane events. Backup or Site Recovery. restore a point in time or replica for regional failover.

1.title: Habits that score points
1.text: Habits that score points. Narrowest scope that works. Least privilege for roles, locks and policy. Built-in feature first. Azure expects the managed feature (alias record, lifecycle rule, autoscale). Constraint words. "least administrative effort", "no downtime", "most secure", "lowest cost". Read the diagram or portal. Case studies hide the answer in the details. Old names. Azure A D means Microsoft Entra I D. Exam tip: Answer every question. Mark the hard ones and come back with the time left. Exam tip: Preview features can appear if commonly used, but most questions cover generally available features.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Users in Sales must join a group automatically. What should be used? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: A dynamic group (Entra I D P one or higher). Dynamic groups use rules on user properties.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which role lets a user manage resources but not assign access? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Contributor. Contributor manages resources without assigning roles.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. An organization must prevent resources outside two regions in every subscription. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Azure Policy with Deny at a management group. Policy at a management group enforces region rules.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Data must survive the loss of one availability zone at the lowest cost. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Z R S. Z R S replicates across zones.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A partner needs time-limited read access to a container without the account key. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: A S A S token. A S A S gives limited, time-bound access.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which feature gives a private I P address for a storage account in a V net? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: A private endpoint. A private endpoint places the service on a private I P.

1.title: Practice Question 7
1.text: Question seven. A web tier must add instances when C P U is high. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: A Virtual Machine Scale Set with autoscale. Scale sets autoscale on metrics.

1.title: Practice Question 8
1.text: Question eight. A new app version must go live with no downtime and an easy rollback. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: An App Service deployment slot swap. Slot swaps warm up the new version and can be reversed.

1.title: Practice Question 9
1.text: Question nine. How can a regional outage be survived with V Ms replicated to another region? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Azure Site Recovery. Site Recovery replicates V Ms for failover.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is the passing score? Answer: seven hundred or greater out of one thousand. Question two. What is the old name of Microsoft Entra I D? Answer: Azure Active Directory. Question three. Which tool shows who deleted a resource? Answer: The Activity log.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Is V net peering transitive? Answer: No. Question five. What decides N S G rule order? Answer: The lowest priority number first. Question six. Which feature protects V Ms against datacenter failure inside a region? Answer: Availability zones.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Exam: seven hundred to pass, one hundred minutes, proctored, interactive components possible. Domains: twenty to twenty-five identities, fifteen to twenty storage, twenty to twenty-five compute, fifteen to twenty networking, ten to fifteen monitoring. Habits: narrowest scope, built-in feature, read the constraint. Always: answer every question. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
